title: Conditional kappa 0.001530327580902932: kernel92 plus optimized delivery frames
body:
This composes chafreaky's #533 92-pivot direct504 supplier with the delivery-frame assignment from rohanarun's #534 (Claude-assisted), on icekylinx's #531 architecture.

**Provisional conditional κ = 0.001530327580902932**, about **0.4015% above #533**. Complex lower rate: `0.001532673072778713292743`; the complex supplier remains binding.

The new local profile is `{1:2174,2:496,3:357,4:226,5:139,6:56,7:8}`. Scalar operations, 504 helpers, 92 kernel pivots, helper widths, 7168 live / 7682 physical families, owner assignment and idle remainders stay fixed. Only delivery-operation frames change. The package rebuilds the factory and checks every changed frame is a legal lift of its constructor frame.

Draft submitted before full verification, as requested. Exact provisional pricing, monotone frame lifts, scalar replay in both orientations, independent emitted-local replay and normalized wrappers passed. Full local-phase and downstream physical/invoice verification are running; completed receipts will follow. No completed package replay or CI pass is claimed yet.

Reproduce: `python -B research/kernel92-frame-composition/verify.py /absolute/new/output` (Python 3.11+, standard library, assertions enabled).

The unchanged data-controller/data phases and #493 bit operator are pinned dependencies. All-size compilation, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized wrappers, restored rows, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain conditional. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem or a runtime benchmark.

Prepared for rohanarun with OpenAI Codex assistance. PR534's search/frame assignment and checker retain its Claude Opus 5.5 attribution; #533/#531 and all predecessor notices are preserved. No other worker's PR is modified.
